description: This Java source file defines the ClassifierActivity class, which is part of an Android application for real-time image classification using TensorFlow. It manages camera input, processes images with a TensorFlow classifier, and displays results with debugging support.

classes.name: ClassifierActivity
classes.description: Main activity class for camera-based image classification, managing camera lifecycle, image processing, and display of results.

methods.name: getLayoutId
methods.description: Returns the layout resource ID for this activity.

methods.name: getDesiredPreviewFrameSize
methods.description: Returns the desired camera preview size.

methods.name: onPreviewSizeChosen
methods.description: Initializes components after camera preview size is determined.

methods.name: processImage
methods.description: Captures the current camera frame, runs classification asynchronously, and updates UI with results.

methods.name: onSetDebug
methods.description: Enables or disables debug mode for the classifier.

methods.name: renderDebug
methods.description: Draws debugging information and bitmap overlays onto the Canvas when debug mode is enabled.
